# Kickoff Call Agenda (30 minutes)

The kickoff isn't just a meeting. It's a data-gathering session. Don't execute based on assumptions when you can ask.

| Min | Topic | Questions |
|---|---|---|
| 0–3 | Welcome | Introductions, confirm agenda and who approves work |
| 3–8 | **Goals** | What does success look like in 3 months? How will we measure it? |
| 8–13 | **Situation** | What's happening now? What's been tried? What works / doesn't? |
| 13–18 | **Target** | Who are your best customers? Where do they find you? What do they ask before buying? |
| 18–22 | **Offer** | What exactly do you sell? Prices, best sellers, what makes you different? |
| 22–26 | **Constraints** | Budget, deadlines, resources, approvals, brand rules, internal limits |
| 26–30 | **Next steps** | Confirm timeline, access list, next check-in date, how we'll communicate |

After the call: send notes to the portal, then tick **Kickoff call done** in the dashboard. The access request email is
drafted automatically.
